title: Exec staff meeting prep notes - 2026-03-10
content:
Meeting: Exec staff weekly sync
Date/time: 2026-03-10 09:00-10:00 PT (30m core, 30m buffer)
Owner (prep): Avery Chen
Attendees (TBC): CEO, CTO, Head of Product, Head of Sales, Head of Eng infra, Head of SRE, Head of People

Purpose: quick alignment on top risks and decisions for the coming quarter; unblock cross-functional rollouts (Dedicated GA, Private onboarding flow), review Q1 signal picture, confirm hiring and budget tradeoffs. Keep to 30m decision agenda.

Priority agenda (30m):
1) Launch readiness: Dedicated GA status and risk review (10m)
   - Rollout plan: GA next Tue (2026-03-17) still target.
   - Current blockers: billing integration regression in dedicated capacity (ticket JIRA-5412), limited capacity in us-west-2 for p3dn-compatible SKUs, docs gaps for partner onboarding.
   - Ask for meeting: approve contingency plan to enable reduced feature set for initial GA customers (auto-billing fallback + limited autoscale options).

2) Private deployment pipeline and compliance gating (8m)
   - Status: customer pilot (HealthCo) completed smoke tests; audit log export format not finalized.
   - Risk: KMS/HSM integration timeline slipped 2 weeks due to vendor cert process.
   - Decision requested: greenlight pilot customers with SOC-level controls but with engineered KMS workaround + contractual notes for limited KMS availability.

3) Q1 signal / ops metrics snapshot (6m)
   - Key numbers (last 7 days): hosted API p95 latency 180ms, Dedicated avg throughput at 82% capacity, error rate for large-model generation spiked to 0.9% on 3/7 (investigating).
   - Need to decide: increase Dedicated burst capacity (+15%) for next 2 weeks to avoid throttling during partner demos.

4) Hiring & budget tradeoffs (6m)
   - Proposal: delay non-critical infra hires (2 IC SDE) and instead accelerate SRE hire for on-call coverage.
   - Financial: runway unchanged but Q2 spend profile shifts; CFO to confirm.

Background notes / context (quick bullets):
- JIRA-5412: billing regression surfaced in dedicated path after recent billing SDK update. Eng-re release patch in progress; proposed rollback window 03/11 00:00-04:00 PT.
- Private deployments: pilot checklist attached in Confluence (linked above). Audit-log format decision required before scaling beyond 2 customers.
- Observability: draft dashboard for Dedicated cost breakdown ready; needs product signoff.

Talking points for CEO (3 min):
- Emphasize customer momentum and caution: several enterprise pilots pushing for on-prem options this quarter.
- Ask execs to prioritize immediate customer unblockers (billing patch, temporary capacity uplift, partner docs).

Open questions / unresolved items (notes to self):
- Do we want to permit GA customers to sign up with reduced autoscale (manual scaling) temporarily to avoid delaying GA? Pros/cons to discuss.
- CFO availability to approve temporary +15% Dedicated capacity cost this week? Follow-up needed.
- Legal: draft contractual clause for KMS workaround - who owns final wording? (Legal + Product)

Follow-up action items (after meeting) - initial assignments (rough):
- Action: Approve contingency GA feature-set and communicate to Product & Marketing. Owner: CEO. Due: 2026-03-11
- Action: Engineering to implement rollback or patch for JIRA-5412; schedule maintenance window and notify customers. Owner: Marcus Patel. Due: 2026-03-11
- Action: Increase Dedicated burst capacity by +15% for 2 weeks; procurement & infra to confirm cost and availability. Owner: Head of Infrastructure (Elena Duarte). Due: 2026-03-11
- Action: Legal + Product to draft contractual KMS workaround paragraph for pilot customers. Owner: Samir Rao (Product) + Legal rep (TBD). Due: 2026-03-13
- Action: Product to finalize Dedicated cost dashboard and signoff docs for release notes. Owner: Head of Product. Due: 2026-03-12
- Action: SRE hiring req to be prioritized; People to expedite candidate pipeline. Owner: Head of People. Due: 2026-03-17

Notes to self (informal):
- Keep float on GA comms in case we need to delay public GA by 48h. Prep messaging draft for support leads.
- Remind Sales to pause new GA commitments until patch confirms stability.
- Bring up capacity rental options with cloud partner if us-west-2 SKUs remain constrained.

Appendix / quick links:
- Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/EXEC/2026-03-10-agenda
- JIRA: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/JIRA-5412
- Slack thread (ops-alerts): slack://C011EXAMPLE

Rough timestamps for meeting (for organizer to enforce):
- 09:00-09:03: quick round + objective set (CEO)
- 09:03-09:13: Dedicated GA review (10m)
- 09:13-09:21: Private pilot/compliance (8m)
- 09:21-09:27: Q1 metrics & capacity decision (6m)
- 09:27-09:33: Hiring/budget quick decision (6m)
- 09:33-09:40: Buffer / parking lot items

Status: draft - will update after sync and convert to action tracker.

Personal notes / scratch: keep this doc light - bring only the 'decisions requested' lines to the meeting.
summary: Prep notes for exec staff sync - focus on Dedicated GA blockers (billing bug, capacity), Private deployments KMS delay, short-term capacity uplift decision, hiring priority shift. Draft actions assigned.
